تستعذوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْذُوا (tastaʕḏū) /tas.taʕ.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# تُسْتَعْذَوْا (tustaʕḏaw) /tus.taʕ.ðaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
